behavior_description: Updating Mockito from 4.11.0 to 5.1.1 changes the default MockMaker from the subclass-based ByteBuddyMockMaker to InlineByteBuddyMockMaker. The affected test uses mocked Generator instances where Generator.shrink is a final method. Under Mockito 4.11.0, the final shrink method is not intercepted by the default subclass mock maker, so the real shrink method executes and reaches the stubbed doShrink method, returning [3, 6]. Under Mockito 5.1.1, the default inline mock maker intercepts the final shrink method. Because shrink itself is not stubbed, the mock returns an empty list, changing the observed test result from [3, 6] to [].
notes: PRE with mockito-core 4.11.0: 510 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 18 skipped, BUILD SUCCESS. BREAKING with mockito-core 5.1.1: 510 tests, 1 failure, 0 errors, 18 skipped, BUILD FAILURE. Failing test: CompositeGeneratorTest.shrinkingChoosesAComponentCapableOfShrinkingTheValue. Assertion expected [3, 6] but actual result was []. Generator.shrink(SourceOfRandomness,Object) is final and calls doShrink. Mockito 4.11.0 DefaultMockitoPlugins maps MockMaker to org.mockito.internal.creation.bytebuddy.ByteBuddyMockMaker, while Mockito 5.1.1 maps MockMaker to org.mockito.internal.creation.bytebuddy.InlineByteBuddyMockMaker. No project-specific mockito-extensions override exists. Causal validation: using Mockito 5.1.1 but forcing mock-maker-subclass makes the exact failing test pass with 1 test, 0 failures, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESS. Classified as PROVISIONAL_BEHAVIORAL pending independent review.

behavior_description: After updating Apache Commons IO from 2.7 to 2.11.0, FileUtils.copyFile() throws IllegalArgumentException when the source path refers to a directory rather than a regular file. notes: PRE: commons-io 2.7, BUILD SUCCESS, 345 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 2 skipped. ReportBuilderTest runs 25 tests successfully. BREAKING: commons-io 2.11.0, BUILD FAILURE, 345 tests, 0 failures, 1 error. The affected test is copyCustomResources_OnDirAsFile_ThrowsIOException. The exception originates at org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils.requireFile() and propagates through FileUtils.copyFile() to ReportBuilder.copyCustomResources(ReportBuilder.java:174). The client catches FileNotFoundException and IOException, but not IllegalArgumentException. This is evidence of an exception-behavior change, rather than binary linkage incompatibility. Reviewer 1 classification is PROVISIONAL_BEHAVIORAL. Final classification requires independent second review. A repair has not yet been implemented or verified.
